verses.pali: ekaṁ samayaṁ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṁ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
verses.english: At one time the Buddha was staying near Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.
There the Buddha addressed the mendicants,

verses.pali: “Pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato upāsako sārajjaṁ okkanto hoti.
verses.english: “A lay follower with five qualities is overcome by timidity.

verses.pali: Pāṇātipātī hoti, adinnādāyī hoti, kāmesumicchācārī hoti, musāvādī hoti, surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhāyī hoti.
verses.english: They kill living creatures, steal, commit sexual misconduct, lie, and consume beer, wine, and liquor intoxicants.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato upāsako sārajjaṁ okkanto hoti.
verses.english: A lay follower with these five qualities is overcome by timidity.

verses.pali: Pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato upāsako visārado hoti.
verses.english: A lay follower with five qualities is self-assured.

verses.pali: Pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti, kāmesumicchācārā paṭivirato hoti, musāvādā paṭivirato hoti, surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti.
verses.english: They don’t kill living creatures, steal, commit sexual misconduct, lie, or consume beer, wine, and liquor intoxicants.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato upāsako visārado hotī”ti.
verses.english: A lay follower with these five qualities is self-assured.”
